slices.focus: A lot has shifted lately, and not in some huge dramatic way, more like too many
slices.summary: After soccer travel bills, car repairs, and move costs piled up, Marisa refinances old legal-fee debt and sets up an automatic sinking fund to treat tournament weekends as predictable costs rather than emergencies.
